description: A vertical strip of film has two rectangular picture frames stacked within a rounded outer border. Four short perforations run down each side beside the frames, forming matching sprocket-hole columns.
A circular film reel has four round openings arranged above, below and beside its centre. A short loose film tail extends rightward from the bottom edge with a gently curved tip.
A round film reel has a small central hub surrounded by six short radial marks. A loose strip descends from its right edge and curls upward at the bottom.
A movie camera faces right with a rectangular body, raised top handle and flared lens hood. A short mounting neck supports the body above three long splayed tripod legs.
A person reclines in a cinema chair facing left, with legs extended and a drink cup with a bent straw beside the armrest. A large rectangular screen rises behind the seated figure.
